notes: Watches the official HiKorea boards where 자격별 안내 매뉴얼 are published, so a
new manual (or a changed board listing) is detected automatically instead of a
maintainer having to check the site by hand.
Only hikorea.go.kr / immigration.go.kr hosts are permitted; the fetcher blocks
off-host redirects and caps the response size. Detection NEVER downloads or
promotes a manual and NEVER edits production data — on a change it only opens a
tracking issue for a human to look.
baseline_content_hash follows the same human-bumped-baseline pattern as
data/sources/hikorea_manual_sync.json: after a maintainer processes a detected
change, they update the baseline here so the next change is detected fresh.
A null baseline means 'not yet established' — the first run records the current
fingerprint in its report but does not raise a change.
